name: native-ci-verification
body: Every release runs the offline `eypres init && eypres start` e2e on native GitHub Actions runners for all four targets (macOS arm64, macOS x64, Windows x64, Windows arm64), using the binary built for that target. Cross-compilation alone is not sufficient. A failure on any target blocks publishing. AC: the release workflow shows four green native e2e jobs before the Release is published.
